title: Watersound "At the Waters Edge" 337 Bridge Lane S B101
h1: Watersound "At the Waters Edge" 337 Bridge Lane S B101
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Gulf Views- Shared Pool Access- 4 Adult Bikes- Grill- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThe property does not come with dedicated parking spaces, however 2 vehicles can enter the community for the opportunity to park in the first come first serve parking. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: Gorgeous Emerald Coast views and elegant coastal decor make this WaterSound home an incredible vacation destination! Guests in this property can enjoy 4 bedrooms, 4.5 luxurious bathrooms, and wonderful accommodations for 8 guests. This home features a sunny gulf-facing balcony, a sparkling community pool, and easy access to the sugar white sand beaches!Neutral tones and pops of blue create a peaceful and warm welcome for guests in this home. The galley-style, gourmet kitchen is beautifully equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a 6-burner gas range. The nearby banquette dining table offers a cozy nook for meals, and the formal dining area provides additional guest seating. The second floor main living area is surrounded by large windows, filling this area with abundant natural light. Plush arm chairs and a queen sleeper sofa await in the living room, and from here guests can enjoy the scenic gulf views or a family movie night in front of the large, mounted flat-screen tv. French doors lead to the outdoor porch, where guests can enjoy dining alfresco with a view at the outdoor dining set. The second floor also presents the stunning primary suite, which showcases a plush king bed, French doors to access the balcony, and a private bathroom with a dual-sink vanity, a glass-front shower, and a soaking tub.Guests can choose from three elegant bedrooms down on the first level. The first bedroom offers a plush king bed and a private bathroom with a glass-front shower. The second bedroom has a queen bed with a private bathroom. The final bedroom boasts a full bed as well as a twin bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. This room also features a large, mounted flat-screen television, perfect for enjoying a favorite kids' movie after a long day in the sun! Two cozy chaise loungers on the first-floor porch create a perfect place to enjoy a favorite beach read.This community features a sparkling pool, perfect for splashing in the warm sunshine. The sugar white sands and sparkling emerald waters of Watersound Beach are just a short walk away. Four custom 360 Blue adult beachcruiser bikes offer an easy and breezy way to explore the best local gems along 30A, including our renowned dining and shopping spots. Ready to book your dream getaway in sunny WaterSound? Book your stay in this incredible home!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath, Balcony- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bath, Balcony- Guest Bedroom: Full Bed and Twin Bed, Private Bath, BalconySECOND FLOOR:- PrimaryBedroom: King Bed, Private Bath, Balcony*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watersound "At the Waters Edge" 337 Bridge Lane S B101 Rosemary Beach, FL Bedrooms 4 Beds 4 Sleeps 8 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - Gulf Views - Shared Pool Access - 4 Adult Bikes - Grill - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella) - Private deeded beach access - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout The property does not come with dedicated parking spaces, however 2 vehicles can enter the community for the opportunity to park in the first come first serve parking. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate. Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work. DETAILS: Gorgeous Emerald Coast views and elegant coastal decor make this WaterSound home an incredible vacation destination! Guests in this property can enjoy 4 bedrooms, 4.5 luxurious bathrooms, and wonderful accommodations for 8 guests. This home features a sunny gulf-facing balcony, a sparkling community pool, and easy access to the sugar white sand beaches! Neutral tones and pops of blue create a peaceful and warm welcome for guests in this home. The galley-style, gourmet kitchen is beautifully equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a 6-burner gas range. The nearby banquette dining table offers a cozy nook for meals, and the formal dining area provides additional guest seating. The second floor main living area is surrounded by large windows, filling this area with abundant natural light. Plush arm chairs and a queen sleeper sofa await in the living room, and from here guests can enjoy the scenic gulf views or a family movie night in front of the large, mounted flat-screen tv. French doors lead to the outdoor porch, where guests can enjoy dining alfresco with a view at the outdoor dining set. The second floor also presents the stunning primary suite, which showcases a plush king bed, French doors to access the balcony, and a private bathroom with a dual-sink vanity, a glass-front shower, and a soaking tub. Guests can choose from three elegant bedrooms down on the first level. The first bedroom offers a plush king bed and a private bathroom with a glass-front shower. The second bedroom has a queen bed with a private bathroom. The final bedroom boasts a full bed as well as a twin bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. This room also features a large, mounted flat-screen television, perfect for enjoying a favorite kids' movie after a long day in the sun! Two cozy chaise loungers on the first-floor porch create a perfect place to enjoy a favorite beach read. This community features a sparkling pool, perfect for splashing in the warm sunshine. The sugar white sands and sparkling emerald waters of Watersound Beach are just a short walk away. Four custom 360 Blue adult beachcruiser bikes offer an easy and breezy way to explore the best local gems along 30A, including our renowned dining and shopping spots. Ready to book your dream getaway in sunny WaterSound? Book your stay in this incredible home!
